$comment: Semantics probes. corpusRefs re-verify entire oracle corpus tests (every row, both blank modes) against the real product — chosen because they are the current conformance failures or 🔬 items. probes are hand-written cases for NEEDS-VERIFICATION items with no corpus coverage.

corpusRefs.name: testAddDate
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 date + number: fraction truncation, blank date propagation, year range.

corpusRefs.name: testTextFunctionWithCustomDate
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 TEXT(blank date) → null (oracle) vs ""; plus date TEXT format.

corpusRefs.name: testAddConcatSimple
corpusRefs.question: ✅-recheck: + concatenates text; blank text operand behavior (oracle: single blank absorbs, both blank → null — surprising vs 'blank propagates').

corpusRefs.name: testFindOnText
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 FIND with blank search/haystack: oracle says 0, we return blank.

corpusRefs.name: testIfTextCompareGreaterThan
corpusRefs.question: ❓ text ordering comparisons (> on text): collation, case, blank.

corpusRefs.name: testIfContainsFunc
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 CONTAINS with blank args inside IF: blank-propagation vs absorb.

corpusRefs.name: testSimpleSubstitute
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 SUBSTITUTE with blank args: oracle keeps original, we blank out.

corpusRefs.name: testSubstr3
corpusRefs.question: SUBSTR: does the product even have it (OSS-only?); blank length arg → null.

corpusRefs.name: testChr
corpusRefs.question: CHR: product availability; control/space char results (oracle rows look like XML-trim artifacts).

corpusRefs.name: testNVLWithTextArea
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 NULLVALUE over a TextArea field: oracle says null even with fallback — TextArea semantics differ from Text?

corpusRefs.name: testISNULLWithTextArea
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 ISNULL over a TextArea field: oracle says a blank TextArea is null where we say not.

corpusRefs.name: testUpperLocale
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 two-arg UPPER(text, locale): product availability + Turkish İ/ı casing.

corpusRefs.name: testLowerLocale
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 two-arg LOWER(text, locale): product availability + Turkish casing.

corpusRefs.name: testExponentiationOperator
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 ^ result scale: oracle materializes ^ at ~20 significant digits, not 32 decimal places — what does the product do?

corpusRefs.name: testBigDivideWithFunc
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 VALUE(TEXT(blank)) under blank mode: null (oracle) vs #Error (ours).

corpusRefs.name: testSubUnary
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 unary minus of a blank number in blank mode: null (oracle) vs 0 (ours).

corpusRefs.name: testOriginDateTime
corpusRefs.question: 🔬 $System.originDateTime: does the product expose it, and is it 1900-01-01 GMT?
